page.layout: Running head at top, centred: "Prolegomena." One main text column, with notes in the left margin: "† Pag.498." beside the first paragraph, "q" with its reference beside the second line of the first paragraph, and "§. VIII." with a small marginal heading beside the section heading. A full-width italic section heading sits above the second paragraph. No page number, catchword, or signature beyond the word at the foot right.

main_text.l: {†}Ut spiritualis asinus, miraculi causâ, claudum humeris por-
tabat. Cui forte quis rectius, quod de claudo clamoso
populus apud Poëtam, Quare peregrinum. Hæc (ut alia
multa omittam) satis ostendunt ex quàm turbidis fonti-
bus quam cœnosos riuulos Bellarminus in Tractatum
suum deriuauerit: de quibus illud Theologi Pontificij
merito vsurpem.; {q}Dolenter dico potiùs quam contumeliosè,

l.i: multò à Lactio[?], & ethnicis Historicis Philosophorum
vitas seueriùs scriptas, quàm à Christianis vitas Sanctorum.

main_text.l: Cum itaque, ne frustra sint libri, inter Authorem ac
Lectorem semper supponatur proportio, insignem certè
Principibus intulit Bellarminus contumeliam, dum huius-
modi fabulatorum quisquilias ijs apponit, quasi muscas
à cæcis devorandas.

l.i: Applicationem Exemplorum, de Principum humilitate, ad
ipsorum honorem imminuendum, egregiè à Bellarmino

main_text.l: Sunt quos Exemplis, sunt quos Præceptis erudiri iu-
uat: ab exemplis facilior & tritior, à præceptis tutior
firmiorque discendi ratio proponitur. Bellarminus pieta-
tis iustitiæque regulam absolutam constituit in Sanctorum
suorum duntaxat Exemplis; {r}Quæ (inquit) qui Princeps s-
equitur errare non poterit. At qui ad hominum, quam-
uis Sanctorum, Exempla mores aliorum fingi & efforma-
ri volunt, perinde mihi facere videntur (nam quot in
sacra pagina sanctorum Patriarcharum, Sacerdotum, Prophe-
tarum, Regum, & Apostolorum commemorantur:)
acsi dent operam vt imitentur Ethnicorum quorundâ in-
saniam; inter quos Poëtæ bibacitatem Ennij; Philoso-
phi contractos Platonis humeros, Aristotelisque balbutiem;
Milites Alexandri Imp. proiectam ceruicem, leui-
tatem oculorum, & vocis quandam asperitatem agrestem;
Subditi denique (vt apud Aethiopes) Regum suorum mor-
bos imitati sunt. Sanctos igitur vltra humanam for-
tem

page.notes: The first word of the page-top paragraph is printed in italic; the dagger-like mark before it is read as †. The reference after "q" and the marginal word "Incipit" are doubtful and marked [?]. "Lactio" may be a shortened form of Lactantio and is marked [?]. The large initial S is joined to "unt" as "Sunt". The margin text beside the section heading is set in small type and is given as one note. Faint show-through lines of the reverse side are omitted.
